## Release metadata

Most pull requests do not publish a release. Use a dedicated release PR when preparing a version:

- [ ] `VERSION` contains the next `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.
- [ ] `RELEASE_NOTES.md` contains the user-facing notes for that version.
- [ ] This is a dedicated release PR intended to publish that version after merge.
- [ ] Tests pass locally or the reason they cannot be run is documented below.
